summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend validation of Suvio AI Phase 1 upgrades. 15/15 pytest cases pass; UI verified end-to-end (send/stream, thinking indicator, search filter, rename, stop generation with [Stopped] marker, copy/regen buttons, voice output toggle w/ rate selector, markdown table rendering).

issues: Non-blocking Next.js metadata warning: 'Unsupported metadata themeColor... move it to viewport export'. Cosmetic, not functional.

action_items: OPTIONAL: The AI has STRICT scope refusal (line ~1600 in route.js). A prompt like 'give me python hello world in a code block' is now refused as off-topic and never triggers hljs code-block rendering. This is by design — but if E1 still wants to demonstrate .hljs highlighting in the QA, either soften the refusal to still emit code fences, or update review-checklist to test code rendering against an in-scope prompt (e.g. showing a JSON snippet of tasks). Markdown ReactMarkdown itself is proven working (no '[object Object]'; tables render correctly).
Move themeColor from metadata export to viewport export in Next.js pages to silence the console warning.
critical_code_review_comments: route.js is 1900+ lines — beyond the 700-line guideline. Consider splitting into modules per feature (auth/, ai/, plan/, support/). Not a bug, but a maintainability concern.
The streaming AI system prompt (ai/chat/stream) is a large multi-line template literal — consider extracting to /lib/prompts.js for reuse and testability.

The `_stream_chat` fixture originally lost its tuple unpacking (already fixed here). Frontend fetch of `/api/ai/history` after streaming waits ~1.5s to ensure Mongo persistence; consider awaiting the DB write inside the SSE 'done' event on the server so clients don't need to sleep.

The free-plan daily AI limit is 10 msgs/day and triggers on the very first message before validating the payload — /api/ai/chat/stream should validate `message` before consuming a slot; test user was upgraded to premium to run the full suite (recorded below).
test_credentials: Phone +15551234567 / Test1234!  (DEV OTP 000000). User was upgraded in DB to planTier='premium' to bypass the 10 msg/day free limit during automated testing — revert if needed for free-plan QA.
seed_data_creation: Test user +15551234567 was updated to planTier='premium' and aiUsage cleared. Also created (and later renamed to 'TEST_UI_Rename') and deleted temporary AI conversations. History records for prompts like 'Reply with the single word: hello', 'Hello Suvio!', 'What did I just say?', 'add a task', 'delete all my tasks', 'I spent Rs 500 on lunch today', 'Give me a markdown table…' etc. remain in the ai_messages collection under this user.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The AI streaming endpoint has STRICT scope refusal — coding-help / general-knowledge prompts return the canned 'I'm Suvio AI. I can only help…' message. To test markdown rendering use in-scope prompts (tables of tasks, insights, spending). Backend pytest runs sequentially via `-n 0` because pytest.ini forces `-n 2 --dist loadscope`, and the AI history fixture needs deterministic ordering. Test-user tier was set to premium to bypass 10 msg/day free-tier daily limit.
rca of the issue: N/A — no unresolved bugs. The only apparent 'failure' (no .hljs on code prompt) is by-design AI scope refusal. Backend and frontend both function correctly for every listed Phase 1 upgrade.
